verdict.rationale: Unleash documents reusable segments, described as collections of strategy constraints defined once and reused across any number of flags. It also documents constraints on context fields with operators (e.g. currentTime with DATE_AFTER), activation strategies that target certain users, targeting rules on user IDs, emails and IPs, and strategy variants for exposing different versions to users. A dated community comment calls its rule system more limited than LaunchDarkly's, but it gives no concrete failure, so it lowers confidence rather than the verdict. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the attribute operator set for user-defined context fields, and independent hands-on corroboration of segment and variant targeting.

support.subject: As a developer, I can target flags with attribute-based rules and reusable segments so the right users see the right variation
